prerequisites.detail: Built artifacts, local image, configuration and doctor checked

initial_evidence_deadline.detail: Initial positive events, expected alerts and exact host PID must appear within 15 seconds

shell_alert.detail: First container sh must match docker-shell

discovery_alert.detail: First container id must match docker-discovery

sleep_event_no_alert.detail: First container sleep must have an event and no alert

second_container_attribution.detail: Second container id must carry its own exact container ID and name

host_no_docker_alert.detail: Observed exact host id PID must never receive Docker attribution or a Docker rule alert

failed_exec_no_event.detail: Nonexistent executable must fail with no successful exec record; later success must be observed

late_container_attribution.detail: New container must become attributable and alert within 20 seconds

directory_lock.detail: Second instance must fail with the output-directory lock error

graceful_stop.detail: Expected clean exit after SIGINT within 10 seconds

restart_event.detail: Restarted collector must save and alert on a real container id exec

restart_graceful_stop.detail: Expected clean exit after SIGINT within 10 seconds

cleanup.detail: Only label-verified containers created by this run were removed

notes: These checks use real kernel events, not synthetic replay.
The copied test configuration sets include_host=true so the host negative assertion requires an observed host PID. Default rules and the production configuration are unchanged.
Negative assertions cover the recorded verification interval, not all possible executions or a claim of zero event loss.
